allow_instructions: Allow the WorkVM helper ~/git/bin/workvm-olie-management-read.sh for read-only Olie forum calls only (get-forum, get-thread, get-thread-data).

Allow shell that only sources ~/.config/environment.d for tokens and then runs read-only curl against https://api.olie.ai/api/management/get-forum, get-thread, get-thread-data, or GET /api/management/projects/{uuid} when resolving funnel-step checklist ids omitted by MCP get-project-details.

Allow read-only MCP and GitHub MCP methods that fetch card, PR, diff, commit, check, file contents, the authenticated GitHub user (get_me), labels, collaborators, or search results without approving, merging, creating, updating, or deleting. Prefer GitHub MCP over shell gh for those reads (Auto-review prompts on gh even for GET).
block_instructions: Ask before create/update/delete on Olie: edit-project, move-project-to-funnel-step, set-form-answers, project-bulk-step-move, and any other management write.
Ask before GitHub writes: approve or request changes on PRs, merge_pull_request, create/update PR, push to remotes, force push.
Ask before git push, destructive git (reset --hard, clean -fd), and docker compose down -v / volume wipes.
